correctness.rationale: The fixed matching is contracted to ten vertices with twenty directed arcs, and deletion uniqueness is equivalent to meeting every directed alternating cycle. The max-forward-arcs subset recurrence proves the minimum feedback-arc count exactly. Backtracking and independent subset-permanent count exactly 60 perfect matchings. Explicit S_5 by layer-swap actions partition them into 6, 24, and 30; exact dynamic programming gives respective anti-forcing values 5, 6, 6 on all 60. An independently coded, full competing-matching transversal enumeration verifies both upper and lower bounds for each representative, and the supplied verifier executed to VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: Anti-forcing is a natural quantitative invariant of uniqueness for perfect matchings. The classification completely determines it on the canonical Desargues graph rather than an arbitrary induced subgraph or gratuitous parameter slice. The exceptional six minima are precisely symmetric Petersen perfect-matching lifts, and the 30-element orbit supplies a motivated boundary showing complementary two-factor length is not sufficient to determine anti-forcing. This is a sharp finite census and reusable benchmark for alternating-cycle feedback-set methods, not a claimed infinite-family theorem.
